name: Nitrites & Nitrates
aliases: E249, E250, E251, E252, nitrite, nitrites, nitrate, nitrates, potassium nitrite, sodium nitrite, sodium nitrate, potassium nitrate
what_is: A group of curing and preservative additives comprising potassium nitrite (E249), sodium nitrite (E250), sodium nitrate (E251) and potassium nitrate (E252).
why_botia: BOTIA groups E249–E252 because labels may use either the E-number or the chemical name. Their authorised uses and maximum levels are product-specific; detecting a declared nitrite or nitrate is not the same as estimating exposure or health risk.
can_1: Detect E249–E252 and their corresponding sodium or potassium nitrite/nitrate names.
can_2: Show that these are regulated preservatives with use conditions that vary by food category.
cannot_1: Determine the amount added, residual amount or total dietary exposure from the ingredient list.
cannot_2: Infer an individual health outcome from the presence of a declared nitrite or nitrate.
